title: Review of the Rentals of State Properties at 26 and 31 Ridout Road
what_it_is: Review of the Rentals of State Properties at 26 and 31 Ridout Road

sections.label: Review of rental matter
sections.summary: The Prime Minister tasked the speaker on 22 May 2023 to review whether proper processes were followed and if there was wrongdoing.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: On 22 May 2023, Prime Minister Lee tasked me to review the matter and establish whether proper processes had been followed and if there had been any wrongdoing.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: Both the CPIB investigation and the Review have been completed.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: On 28 June 2023, the Prime Minister submitted a Miscellaneous Paper to this House attaching the report of my Review as well as the report by CPIB.

sections.label: Review relies on CPIB investigation
sections.summary: The Review would rely on CPIB's investigation to establish facts on the renting out of the two properties.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: As the Prime Minister had already directed CPIB to investigate the renting out of the two properties for corruption or criminal wrongdoing, it was decided, in consultation with the Prime Minister, that my Review would rely on CPIB's investigation to establish the facts surrounding the renting out of these two specific properties.

sections.label: Land size increased
sections.summary: The land size was increased from 9,350 square metres to 23,164 square metres.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: As a result, the land size was increased from 9,350 square metres to 23,164 square metres.

sections.label: Final negotiated rent amount
sections.summary: The final negotiated rent amount was $26,500, which met the minimum rental to be achieved by SLA.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: The final negotiated rent amount was $26,500, which met the minimum rental to be achieved by SLA.

sections.label: Second term rental maintained
sections.summary: The rental for the second term was maintained at $26,500 per month, as determined by SLA.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: The rental for the second term was maintained at $26,500 per month, as determined by SLA, considering the then prevailing market condition." The preceding paragraphs were all quoted verbatim from CPIB's report.

sections.label: AGC directs no further action
sections.summary: AGC agreed with CPIB's findings and directed no further action, concluding no conflict of interest in the rental.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: AGC has reviewed and agreed with CPIB's findings and recommendations and directed that no further action be taken.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: The review concluded that there was no conflict of interest in the rental of these two properties.

sections.label: CPIB rental transaction findings
sections.summary: CPIB found no preferential treatment in the rental transaction and that the SLA Leasing Manager said there was no VVIP policy and all tenants were treated equally.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: CPIB also found that there was no preferential treatment given in the process of the rental transaction.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: In fact, CPIB found that in response to the MA's query on policy for very very important persons (VVIPs), the SLA Leasing Manager had emphasised in her email reply that there was no policy for VVIPs and all prospects and tenants were to be treated equally.

sections.label: Proper conduct in rental transactions
sections.summary: The Ministers, public officers and private sector intermediaries conducted themselves properly in the two rental transactions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: Both the Ministers and the public officers, as well as private sector intermediaries involved, conducted themselves properly in the two rental transactions.

sections.label: Standard declaration for leasing officers
sections.summary: The Public Service Division will work with Ministries and Statutory Boards to introduce a standard declaration requirement for selected officers involved in leasing and valuation matters.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: In addition, the Public Service Division will work with relevant Ministries and Statutory Boards, such as the Housing and Development Board, JTC, the National Environment Agency and SLA to introduce a standard declaration requirement for selected groups of officers who have access to or are involved in leasing and valuation matters.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: Officers in these organisations who have access to privileged information and/or can influence the outcomes of decisions will have to make a declaration before they can rent Government properties managed by their agencies.

sections.label: Ministers did not benefit from information
sections.summary: The review concluded that the Ministers did not benefit from any privileged information.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: The review concluded that the Ministers did not benefit from any privileged information.

sections.label: Rental rates at fair market value
sections.summary: The review established that the rental rates paid by both Ministers were at fair market value and not below market valuation.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: The review also established that the rental rates paid by both Ministers were at fair market value and not below market valuation.

sections.label: Ridout Road rental rates
sections.summary: Chart 1 shows 26 Ridout Road rented at $30.94 per square metre monthly in 2018, and Chart 2 shows 31 Ridout Road at $23.05 in 2019.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: Chart 1 shows that in 2018, the rental per unit gross floor area for the black and white bungalow at 26 Ridout Road was $30.94 per square metre per month.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: Chart 2 shows that in 2019, the rental per unit floor area for 31 Ridout Road at $23.05 per square metre per month was slightly lower than the range of $25.00 to $33.33 per square metre per month for other Ridout Road properties that were tenanted out at the material time.

sections.label: Shanmugam rental equals guide rent
sections.summary: The $26,500 rental Minister Shanmugam paid equalled the correct guide rent on the property.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: In fact, the $26,500 rental Minister Shanmugam paid was equal to the correct guide rent on the property.

sections.label: CPIB on SLA minimum rental
sections.summary: CPIB found SLA was always clear the minimum rental was $26,500 and ensured Minister Shanmugam paid not less than this.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: CPIB found that despite the imprecise use of the term "guide rent", SLA was always clear that the minimum rental to be achieved was $26,500 and ensured that Minister Shanmugam paid not less than this amount.

sections.label: Ridout Road tenancy terms
sections.summary: SLA granted tenancy terms at 26 and 31 Ridout Road based on committed improvement works, and the Review concluded the works matched SLA practices.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: In the case of 26 Ridout Road, SLA granted a tenancy of 3+3+3 years because Mrs Shanmugam had committed to undertake improvement works at a cost in excess of $400,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: In the case of 31 Ridout Road, SLA had granted a tenancy of 3+2+2 upfront as Mrs Balakrishnan had committed to undertake improvement works totalling over $200,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: At the first renewal, Mrs Balakrishnan requested for, and SLA agreed, to an extension of 3+2 years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: The Review also concluded that the works done for the two properties were in keeping with SLA's general practices.

sections.label: 26 Ridout Road works cost
sections.summary: The works for 26 Ridout Road totalled $515,400.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: The works for 26 Ridout Road totalled $515,400.

sections.label: 31 Ridout Road works cost
sections.summary: The works for 31 Ridout Road came to $570,500.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: The works for 31 Ridout Road came to $570,500.

sections.label: SLA amortising recovery costs
sections.summary: SLA recovered the costs from the tenant by amortising it at $2,000 per month over the lease period.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: SLA recovered the costs from the tenant by amortising it at $2,000 per month over the lease period.

sections.label: Ridout Road property rentals
sections.summary: SLA's rental of 26 and 31 Ridout Road to Ministers Shanmugam and Balakrishnan did not deviate from prevailing SLA guidelines for renting black and white bungalows.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: Third, the rental of the state properties at 26 and 31 Ridout Road by SLA to Minister Shanmugam and Minister Balakrishnan did not deviate from the prevailing SLA guidelines and approaches in renting out black and white bungalows for residential purposes.
